scope: Two sequential foreground fullscreen normal-policy runs; same native library and source. Old control retains the new membership index but uses dictionary snapshot traversal. Partial rolling-window attribution; continuous frame distributions. Functional success is not stable FPS.

outdoor.scope: Production motor walking with gravity and collisions through the existing tool-cursor input gate; no density or quality overrides

limits.ram_status: Provisional process-private-commit targets; not system RAM requirements
limits.scope: Budgets detect regressions; they are not allocator caps or proof of 4 GiB GPU compatibility. Saves, history and evidence are not disposable caches.

resources.scope: Process-specific Windows counters, sampled every 0.5 s; driver/instantaneous peaks and other workloads remain unqualified. GPU value sums dedicated allocations across adapters, not whole-device desktop usage.

destruction.scope: Real three-barrel chain, terrain edits, exact shell damage, full unchanged debris population and normal retirement in an owned default-world clone; observer setup drains before gameplay; nested synchronous publication timings overlap, not additive; not collapse, boundary, interrupted-recovery or endurance acceptance
